requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 A0 光敏电阻 和 D9 PWM LED：光线越强 LED 越暗，当光线极强时（>800）蜂鸣器（D6）短鸣提示
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 set to 801 at steady control steps
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 is non-zero (buzzer短鸣提示), io_1 corresponds to a dim LED for stronger light (lower PWM count than when io_0=0), and io_3 is true
